response.sql:
WITH telescope_counts AS (
    SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
    FROM telescopes
    GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
    SELECT telescope_count,
           CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
    FROM telescope_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS value
    FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.value;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories with zero telescopes are excluded because the request identifies observatories through the telescopes table; the average share is therefore across observatories represented in that table.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every observatory in the observatories table, including those with zero telescopes, when calculating the average share and selecting above-average observatories.

    SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
    FROM observatories AS o

),
